 end

 end

 CONFORMED --> FACTS
 FACTS --> PROCESS

 NOTES[\"ARCHITECTURE NOTES<br/><br/>The four conformed dimensions apply across the foundational facts.<br/>Process-specific dimensions apply only where their business meaning is established.<br/><br/>FACT_REPAYMENT retains loan_id as a reference to FACT_LOAN.<br/>remittance_type remains an attribute of FACT_REMITTANCE.<br/><br/>Detailed fact-to-dimension relationships are defined in the individual star-schema diagrams.\"]",
 "config": null

div.div:
ARCHITECTURE NOTES
The four conformed dimensions apply across the foundational facts.
Process-specific dimensions apply only where their business meaning is established.
FACT_REPAYMENT retains loan_id as a reference to FACT_LOAN.
remittance_type remains an attribute of FACT_REMITTANCE.
Detailed fact-to-dimension relationships are defined in the individual star-schema diagrams.
